summary:
**Telepizza (Madrid): analyst summary**

- **Eligibility:** Individuals can franchise it in Spain. Telepizza España says it is looking for businesspeople and franchisees. The franchisor is Telepizza SAU, part of Food Delivery Brands. It is not a master franchise in Spain. Master-franchise deals exist only for other regions.
- **Fee and investment:** The official site says investment starts from €80,000 and there is no entry fee. Directories quote higher totals, from about €150,000 to €100,000–300,000.
- **Royalty and marketing:** Directories (Tormo, franquicia.net) show 6% royalty and 4% advertising. Older listings show 5% and 3%. I found no official figure.
- **Premises:** I found no franchise disclosure document. Telepizza helps with the site search and pre-opening steps, which points to a market lease that you find and sign yourself. I found no evidence of franchisor-owned sites or rent charged as a % of sales. Confirm this directly with Telepizza.
- **Sales per unit:** There is no official figure. A well-located unit can exceed €400,000 a year. Spain chain sales were €369.4M in 2018.
- **Risks:** Food Delivery Brands lost €48.19M in 2025. It bought 16 franchised stores in Spain and plans more company-run stores. One press report says an audit questions its continuity.

data.eligibility_explanation: Telepizza SAU (Food Delivery Brands) recruits individual franchisees directly in Spain (telepizza.es/info/franquicias.html, franquiciastelepizza.es). It is not a master franchise in Spain. Master-franchise agreements apply to other regions (franquicia.net). The group is buying back franchised stores and expanding company-run stores (2025 accounts), so ask about territory availability in Madrid.
data.operator_in_spain: Telepizza SAU / Food Delivery Brands, S.A.

spain_store_count.source: https://www.telepizza.es/info/franquicias.html (says 'más de 700'; franquiciastelepizza.es says '+650'; 715 in 2022 per El Español)

franchise_fee_eur.label: verified (official site says no entry fee; some directories list a fee by population, e.g. franquicialist €24,000)

min_floor_area_m2.source: https://feriadefranquicias.com/es/franquicias/franquicias/telepizza (from 45 m2 depending on model; standard stores 80 m2 per infofranquicias.com and franquishop)

data.rent_model_explanation: Telepizza advises on site search, design and build, but no source says the franchisor owns the site or charges rent as % of sales. The franchisee appears to lease on the open market, subject to franchisor approval. This is an inference with no FDD, so confirm with the franchisor.

auv_eur.label: third_party_estimate
auv_eur.note: Low = 'can exceed €400k' (franquicialist). Mode = my approximation: 2018 Spain chain sales €369.4M divided by about 715 stores (the 2022 count, so mixed years). High = sector average for franchised restaurants (~€800k). No Telepizza or Madrid-specific AUV was found.

unit_m2.label: third_party_estimate
unit_m2.note: Formats: delta 80-100 m2, traditional 140-160 m2, small or shopping-centre units 45-80 m2. Mode is my judgement for Madrid.

cogs_pct.label: third_party_estimate
cogs_pct.note: Spanish quick-service restaurant benchmark (food cost 30-35%), widened to 28%. Not Telepizza-specific. Includes packaging and product bought from the franchisor's factory.

labour_pct.label: third_party_estimate
labour_pct.note: Benchmark for Spanish fast-food/take-away (20-30%). Delivery-heavy models may sit toward the high end.

royalty_pct.label: third_party_estimate
royalty_pct.note: Current directories say 6%. Older listings (emprendedores.es, asest) say 5%. Not confirmed by an official page.

marketing_pct.label: third_party_estimate
marketing_pct.note: Advertising levy. 4% in current directories, 3% in older ones.

other_opex_pct.label: third_party_estimate
other_opex_pct.note: Spanish restaurant benchmark: rent 6-10% + utilities 2-5% + other operating costs 8-10%. Includes market-lease rent, so occupancy is not shown separately. Delivery-platform commissions may add more. Excludes depreciation and financing.

investment_eur.label: low verified (official 'desde'); mode and high third_party_estimate
investment_eur.note: Excludes any lease deposit or working capital that the franchisor figure may not cover. Ask what is included. Mode is a press-department figure, not specific to Madrid.

notes: Mode cost lines sum to about 89% of sales, which leaves roughly 11% pre-depreciation margin. Asest (third party) says 10-15% net; skello says 8-12% for fast food. This is not a Telepizza-verified figure.
No Spanish franchise disclosure document or official unit economics were found. Use the Spanish pre-contract information the franchisor must provide.
Contract term is 10 years, not renewable according to feriadefranquicias. Minimum population is 12,000-15,000.

Franchisor risk: Food Delivery Brands lost €48.19M in 2025 on €286M revenue and EBITDA of €29.8M (eleconomista.es, July 2026). It acquired 16 Spanish franchised stores and intends more company-run stores. A 2024 press report (xataka.com) cites an audit questioning continuity.
